updates.title: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Trading Bay Production Airport, Trading Bay, AK
updates.summary: This action establishes Class E airspace extending upward from 700 feet above the surface at Trading Bay Production Airport, Trading Bay, AK. This action supports the safety and management of instrument flight rules (IFR) operations at the airport.

updates.title: Mattresses From India: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part, of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that producers/exporters subject to this review made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), March 1, 2024, through August 31, 2025. In addition, we are rescinding the review with respect to four companies. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.

updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that certain producers/exporters subject to this review made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), March 1, 2024, through February 28, 2025.

updates.title: Safety Zone; Brownsville Ship Channel, Brownsville, TX
updates.summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters on the Brownsville Ship Channel. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with an over-sized dead ship tow transiting the area. updates.title: VIAVI Solutions; Filing of Color Additive Petition
updates.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is announcing that we have filed a color additive petition, submitted by VIAVI Solutions, proposing that the color additive regulations be amended to provide for the safe use of magnesium fluoride-aluminum flake for use in nail polish at a maximum level of 16 percent of the final product.
